# Random genomes traced by the C++ reference (cbuild/work/avida -a,
# analyze LOAD_SEQUENCE... + TRACE trace_out/ 0 -1 <random>) with the
# heads_default_100u config and the instruction set given per batch.
# SEQ <sequence> <fnv1a64 of the trace> <trace length in bytes>
# Batches hold nop-A/B/C plus 59 ported instructions each, 80-instruction
# genomes drawn uniformly. Left out because the reference binary exits or
# crashes on them in a test CPU: throw/goto families (exit without marker),
# sleep, interrupts, else and the if-*-end family (the avd_* port looks up
# "endif" with cInstSet::GetInst, which exits), and rotate-uphill, die,
# get-res-stored, h-copy-res (segfault).
